Configure governance on model serving endpoints (legacy)

Usage tracking shares system.serving.endpoint_usage and system.serving.served_entities.

The input and output token count are estimated as (text_length+1)/4 if the token count is not returned by the model.

Column name Description Type
account_id Account. STRING
workspace_id Workspace. STRING
databricks_request_id Request ID. STRING
request_time Request time. TIMESTAMP
input_token_count The token count of the input. LONG
output_token_count The token count of the output. LONG
served_entity_id Served entity. STRING
